description: This file defines the MappingConfig interface for configuring message mapping behavior within the Connectivity service. It includes methods to retrieve buffer sizes, parallelism settings, and JavaScript configuration, along with an enumeration of default configuration values.

classes.name: MappingConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for the message mapping behavior in the Connectivity service.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size used for the queue in the message mapping processor actor responsible for doing enrichment.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the parallelism used for enriching messages in parallel in message mapping processor actor.

methods.name: getMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the max pool size (parallelism) for mapping inbound and outbound messages, limiting user-settable configuration.

methods.name: getJavaScriptConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the JavaScript message mapping.

methods.name: getMapperLimitsConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of mapper limits.

classes.name: MappingConfig.MappingConfigValue
classes.description: An enum of the known configuration path expressions and their default values.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with the config path.

methods.name: MappingConfig.getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size for the message mapping queue.

methods.name: MappingConfig.getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the parallelism level for message enrichment.

methods.name: MappingConfig.getMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum pool size for message mapping.

methods.name: MappingConfig.getJavaScriptConfig
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript message mapping configuration.
